title: Revalidation response (200)
description: The body the front end returns with status 200 after it has accepted a revalidation batch: the paths it revalidated. WordPress stores the status and this body in the post's _rh_last_revalidation meta and shows them to the editor as an admin notice.

revalidated.description: Every front-end path the batch caused to be revalidated, each absolute from the site root (for example /resources/ or /resources/webinar/example/). The union over all events in the batch, for the editor's information; the front end also invalidates cache tags, which are not listed here.
